title: Five Workers, a Grandmother's Plot and a Three-Kilo Pair of Shoes
conflicts: Founding year: slate and SBS (2019) say 2005; her own interviews with Wharton (2012) and ILO (2015) say 2004, as do AWiB's 'nine years ago' (2013) and The Long + Short's 'a decade on' (2014); used 2004. Workforce figures range from 'hundreds' (2012) to 120 (2013), 'more than 100 local' (2015) and 300 (2019); used ILO's conservative figure, attributed. Store counts and revenue omitted because sources disagree and The Long + Short warns she cites projected turnover.
notes: Three-kilo first pair, laughter at the first exhibition, under-USD-5,000 start and the 5,000-pair order come from AWiB's report of her 2013 talk and are attributed to her. A secondary profile site (not cited) gives six kilograms for the first prototypes.
